tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Total Curvature Theorem] ↗ thm:gauss-bonnet-formula 1. ch9:9.6

If $\gamma :[a,b]\to \mathbb R^2$ is smooth, unit speed, simple, and closed, $\gamma '(a)=\gamma '(b)$, and $N$ is its inward normal, then \[ \int _a^b\kappa _N(t)\, dt=2\pi . \]
